extra.message: The Flask secret key is hardcoded as 'Harry Potter And The Deathly Hallows'. Flask uses this key to cryptographically sign session cookies; anyone who knows it can forge arbitrary session cookies (e.g., set logged_in=True) and bypass authentication entirely.

extra.message: app.debug = True enables the Werkzeug interactive debugger, and the app is served on host 0.0.0.0 (line 211), exposing it to the network. On any unhandled exception the debugger serves an interactive Python console that can execute arbitrary code (remote code execution) and leaks stack traces and source code. Debug mode must never be enabled in a deployed application.
